card.fires_on: Punctuation, small words or spaces right before the next heading or label in a document, such as Prevention, Editor, Drug Interactions or a table column. It fires at the spot where a new labeled section is about to begin.

modes.label: Section or table labels
modes.description: Small words or separators just before a heading or column label such as Editor, Species or Description.

modes.label: Sentence end before new heading
modes.description: A period closing a sentence just before a bolded-style heading like Prevention or Management.
modes.example: additive effects on heart rate<<.>> Prevention or Management: Treatment with ZE
